description.en: The IP address of the node.

description.zh: 云原生ACK架构集群的节点名称，可调用[ListAllNode](~~183958~~)接口获取。
description.en: The node name of the cloud-native ACK-based cluster. You can call the [ListAllNode](~~183958~~) operation to obtain the node name.

description.zh:
节点类型，可选值：

- WORKER：热节点
- WORKER_WARM：冷节点
description.en:
The node type. Valid values:

- WORKER: hot node
- WORKER_WARM: warm node
The access port number of the node.

description.zh: 实例节点所在的可用区ID。例如，上海可用区C为cn-shanghai-c。
description.en: The zone ID of the node in the instance. For example, the zone ID of China (Shanghai) Zone C is cn-shanghai-c.

description.zh:
是否忽略集群健康状态：

- true：忽略
- false（默认）：不忽略
description.en:
Specifies whether to ignore the cluster health status.

- true: ignores the cluster health status.
- false (default): does not ignore the cluster health status.

description.zh:
需要缩容的节点类型，可选值：

- WORKER：热节点
- WORKER_WARM：冷节点
description.en:
The type of nodes to scale in. Valid values:

- WORKER: hot node
- WORKER_WARM: warm node

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch validate-shrink-nodes --instance-id es-cn-nif1q9o8r00080000 --node-type WORKER --ignore-status false --count 2 --biz-body hostName=es-cn-pl32xxxxxxx-data-f-1 port=9200 host=192.168.xx.xx zoneId=cn-shanghai-c nodeType=WORKER --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun elasticsearch POST /openapi/instances/es-cn-nif1q9o8r00080000/validate-shrink-nodes --region cn-hangzhou --count 2 --nodeType WORKER --ignoreStatus false --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body [{"hostName":"es-cn-pl32xxxxxxx-data-f-1","port":9200,"host":"192.168.xx.xx","zoneId":"cn-shanghai-c","nodeType":"WORKER"}]
